goal: Revise the preserved implicit-fragment callback WIP in place to the Q-approved manual six-digit invitation-code flow and prove literal zero credential retention.

Password rejection or unconfirmed password response keeps only the verified memory session and shows password-only retry. Completion uses best-effort local signout plus mandatory disposal. No business API, staff acceptance or identity binding runs in the callback.

Keep the previously reviewed staff list/revoke-only screen, raw-link/public-signUp deletion, legacy staff fail-closed route and unchanged participant request-link flow. Use existing Wire components/CSS and the corrected WireError accessibility behavior.

No email, code, password, session, subject or marker in React state/errors/logs/URL/history/storage/non-Auth requests. The only transient protocol values are the uncontrolled inputs before reset and Auth request bodies after reset.
verification: Before editing, read skill://frontend-lane, skill://design-lane and DESIGN-RULES.md; use no shared UI/CSS/token change.
Use LSP references for exported symbol cutover when available; otherwise prove zero forbidden residual symbols and current participant paths remain.
Run direct targeted tests: pnpm --filter @ccc/client exec vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/business/auth.test.ts src/screens/invites.test.ts.

Run the exact actualBrowserZeroRetentionMatrix in the frozen contract with synthetic signed installation/Auth responses only. Inspect Chrome diagnostic DocumentURL/UserTypedURL metadata and require zero matches because the clean invitation URL carries no credential.

Obtain separate read-only security and design reviews of the final nine-file diff and rendered screens. Apply in-scope findings, rerun affected checks, close all tabs/services and delete unsanitized fixture evidence.
Commit only the nine explicit paths with configured hooks. Do not bypass hooks, change Auth templates, use credentials, send an invite, push, merge or deploy.
report: Print marker, parent/commit SHA, exact paths, tests/typecheck/build, browser zero-retention matrix, review verdicts, clean state and blockers.
